Methodology

How Rankings Are Produced

01

Forward point model

Regularized position models learn lagged role, volume, efficiency, and opponent context. Depth is selected only on the prior validation season.

02

Calibrated range

Out-of-sample residuals calibrate each P10–P90 band. Confidence tiers describe measured historical error, not model certainty.

03

Lineup-constrained simulation

Current depth-chart scenarios force teammates to share finite targets, carries, attempts, and touchdowns before replacement value and upside are ranked.
